candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned value from true to false to invert the function's boolean result.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of always true, changing observable return depending on callee behavior.
Return false if any low-level call failed; previously always returned true, now returns aggregated success.
Insert an explicit require that the last low-level call succeeded, causing a revert (not just false) when it fails, changing observable completion and return behavior for some inputs.
Change the selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom(...) so external calls target a different function signature, altering observable effects.
Change call to use delegatecall instead of call so the invoked code runs in this contract's context, altering state-visible behavior.
Insert a require that the external call succeeds, reverting on failure which changes whether state changes from external calls are observed after transfer returns.
Change the loop to iterate from end to start (reverse order), altering the order of external calls and thus observable state after transfer completes.
Omit passing the `from` parameter to the external call (use address(0)), potentially changing how the callee updates state and thus observable behavior.
